newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News says Star TV losses as expected.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News says Star TV losses as expected.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said losses from its Asian-based Star TV operation were in line with expectations as the satellite broadcaster continued its regional expansion.

"Included among its recent accomplishments was the October launch of STAR Plus in India as a Hindi-focused service, as well as the January launch of Star Select, a six-channel package specifically targeting the Middle East on the Orbit Network, a digital multi-channel platform serving 23 territories in the Middle East and Africa," the global media group said in a commentary accompanying its 1996/97 first half profit result.

The company did not specify the profit performance of the Hong Kong-based satellite tv operation which faces stiff competition in key markets and has faced a number of political and regulatory hurdles in some countries.
News Corp chairman and founder Rupert Murdoch said at the annual meeting in October last year that Star TV was performing well and had a great outlook.
News Corp reported a half year net profit of A$690 million down from A$702 million a year earlier.
The result was at the bottom end of expectations.
